purpose: The Refund Service handles refund requests from merchants and support agents, checks them, tracks their status, and notifies other services of changes.

components.name: Refunds Gateway
components.evidence: The door of the service. All requests from the merchants and from the support console come to this door first and it hands them to the core.

components.name: refund-core
components.evidence: The service with the logic: it keeps the rules of what can be refunded, the states of a refund and the approval.

components.name: refund-db
components.evidence: The database with the refund records. A record has the id of the payment, the amount, the currency, the reason and the state.

components.name: refund-events
components.evidence: A line of messages, so the other services (the ledger, the notification service) hear about every change.
